integrity: Proof uses an exact finite quotient graph and two exhaustive independent graph implementations. Bounded direct state iteration is corroboration, not the uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-point exclusions at the sixth and seventh multiples are proved. Does not classify all cycles or special-seed periods. Earlier unindexed equivalent arguments cannot be ruled out. No independent audit performed.
title: Universal sixfold and sevenfold fixed-point exclusion for a ternary quadratic permutation
